leaf-envelope.description: strict leaf envelope verification: model, identity, keys policy, literal test binding, artifact integrity, build claim, no controller-future claims
check_groups: model (C/R/E existence, single-parent, diffs, envelope placement, R non-empty)
identity (schema/lab/batch/leaf/lease exact, OIDs exact, object format exact)
external branch binding (remote=origin, planned branch present/exact)
top-level keys policy (required present, unknown rejected, forbidden self/controller keys rejected)
leaf literal tests (exact ID set, command_sha256 byte-exact, exit 0, timestamps ordered)
artifacts (exact set == C..R, sha256/size from R blobs, kinds allowed, non-empty)
leaf build claim (LAB-A not_applicable w/o invented fields; LAB-B claimed_built structurally valid)

full-completion.description: leaf-envelope PLUS controller acceptance receipt verification and independent re-execution
check_groups: receipt schema/fields, equalities (E/tree/blob/sha256), remote branch == expected, remote resolved OID == E
controller literal tests: exact IDs, exit 0 declared AND reexecuted on clean R with stdout/stderr hashes
acceptance harness sha256 + verdict PASS on clean R
controlled rebuild (LAB-B: empty build dir, frozen command, output sha256/size == leaf claim; LAB-A: not_applicable)
worktree clean before/after, completion criteria all true, final verdict PASS

selftest.description: 43 checks with real temporary git repositories; every positive and negative fixture is constructed fresh

LAB-A: functional lifecycle probe (owned lifecycle, foreign survival, failure propagation, no global cleanup)

provenance.principle: equality/difference of hashes is never sufficient proof of copy or rebuild
provenance.leaf_claim_vs_controller_evidence: leaf_build_claim is a claim only; controller acceptance receipt A records controller rebuild evidence; A never inside E
